selection_basis: Facilities/inspection remains 30 questions below its 50-question production target after B6 verified 20 source-bound questions. B18 deepens the target using the frozen current e-Gov source path for preventive regulations, periodic inspection, safety inspection and remaining application/procedure boundaries, while explicitly excluding B6 propositions already covering basic installation/change permission, completion inspection, provisional use, certificate handling and the generic periodic-inspection duty.

pinpoint_scope: 危険物の規制に関する規則 第60条の2〜第62条の予防規程・定期点検に関する該当条項
危険物の規制に関する規則 第62条の2〜第62条の8の保安検査等に関する該当条項
消防法・危険物の規制に関する政令のうち上記手続・検査の根拠となる該当条項
source_contract.locator_rule: Every candidate must bind to one registered current e-Gov source/version and the exact article/paragraph/item directly supporting its answer. Do not use chapter-only locators and do not reconstruct a B6 proposition by wording change.

planned_families: preventive-regulation applicability, approval, change and procedural boundaries not already canonical
periodic-inspection applicability, frequency, performer and record-detail boundaries beyond the B6 generic duty
safety-inspection application, procedure, timing and exception boundaries beyond the B6 10000-kL target example
remaining permission/completion application fields or attachment requirements that are materially distinct from B6
authority, applicant and facility-responsibility distinctions tied to one exact current-law provision
permission versus approval versus notification versus inspection misconceptions only when one cited provision directly defines the tested distinction
anti_duplication_rule: Do not recreate B6 C001-C020 propositions: basic installation/change permission, permission standards, completion inspection before use, provisional use, transfer notice, 10-day quantity-change notice, maintenance/order duties, completion-inspection application/timing/certificate/reissue, basic application fields, generic pre-completion inspection, the 10000-kL safety-inspection example, or the generic periodic-inspection-and-record duty.
